ELECTION COMMISSION OF INDIA 
ORDER 
New Delhi, the Ist January, 2026 


O.N. 5.—WHEREAS, the General Election to Legislative Assembly of Rajasthan, 2023 for 141-Ahore 
Assembly Constituency was held in pursuance of the Election Commission of India Notification No.464/RJ-LA/2023, 
dated 30" October, 2023; and 


WHEREAS, as per Section 78 of the Representation of the People Act, 1951, every contesting candidate at an 
election shall, within 30 days from the date of election of the returned candidate, lodge with the District Election Officer 
an account of his election expenses which shall be true copy of the account kept by him or his election agent under Section 
77 of the said act; and 


WHEREAS, the result of the above-mentioned election from 141-Ahore Assembly Constituency of 
Rajasthan, 2023 was declared by the Returning Officer on 37 December, 2023 and hence the last date for lodging the 
account of Election Expenses was 2™ January, 2024; and 


WHEREAS, as per the report submitted by DEO, Jalore report dated 09.01.2024 forwarded by the Chief 
Electoral Officer, Rajasthan vide his letter no. F.3(1)(5)EEM/ELECTION/Candidates’ Exp. /433 dated 16.01.2024, under 
sub-rule (1) of Rule 89 of the Conduct of Elections Rules, 1961, Sh. Masara Ram a contesting candidate from 141- 
Ahore Assembly Constituency of state of Rajasthan has failed to lodge account of election expenses, as required under 
law; and 


WHEREAS, on the basis of the said report of the District Election Officer, Jalore a Show-Cause notice No. 
76/RJ-LA/141/2023/CEMS-I, dated 107" July, 2024 was issued under sub rule (5) of Rule 89 of the Conduct of 
Elections Rules, 1961 by the Election Commission of India to Sh. Masara Ram for not lodging of account of Election 
Expenses; and 


WHEREAS, through the above said Show Cause Notice and under sub rule (6) of Rule 89 of the Conduct of 
Elections Rules, 1961, Sh. Masara Ram was directed to submit representation in writing to the Commission explaining 
the reasons for not lodging the account and also to lodge account of election expenses with the District Election Officer, 
Jalore within 20 days from the date of receipt of the notice; and 


WHEREAS, the District Election Officer, Jalore vide his letter no. P. (1) (1) L-A.Ele./Exp. Mo./2024/3050 
dated 22.11.2024 has informed that the notice was duly served and received by Sh. Masara Ram, on dated 
12.11.2024; and 


WHEREAS, the District Election Officer, Jalore in his Supplementary Report, vide its letter no. P. (1) 
(1) L.A.Ele./Exp. Mo./2024/3054 dated 16.12.2024 has reported that Sh. Masara Ram has not submitted account of 
election expenses. Further, after receipt of the said notice, Sh. Masara Ram has neither furnished any reason nor 
explanation to the Election Commission of India, for failure to lodge the account of his election expenses as 
prescribed under law; and 


WHEREAS, Section 10 A of the Representation of the People Act, 1951 provides that:- 
“If the Election Commission is satisfied that a person- 


(a) has failed to lodge an account of election expenses, within the time and in the manner required by or under 
this Act, and 


(b) has no good reason or justification for the failure, 


the Election Commission shall, by order published in the Official Gazette, declare him to be disqualified 


, 


and any such person shall be disqualified for a period of three years from the date of the order.”’; 


16 THE GAZETTE OF INDIA : MAY 16, 2026/V AISAKHA 26, 1948 [PART II—SEC. 3(iii)] 


WHEREAS, on the basis of facts and available records, the Commission is satisfied that Sh. Masara 
Ram has failed to lodge account of election expenses and has no good reason or justification for the failure to do so; 
and 


NOW, THEREFORE, in pursuance of Section 10A of the Representation of the People Act, 1951, the 
Election Commission of India hereby declares Sh. Masara Ram, residence of Sanvara, Tehsil-Ahore, District- 
Jalore, Rajasthan, a contesting candidate from 141-Ahore Assembly Constituency of Rajasthan in General 
Election to Legislative Assembly, 2023 to be disqualified for being chosen as and for being a member of either House 
of the Parliament or the Legislative Assembly or the Legislative Council of a State or Union Territory for a period of 
three years from the date of this order. 


[F. No. 76/RJ-LA/141/2023/CEMS-I] 
By Order, 
RAKESH KUMAR, Secy.

WHEREAS, as per Section 78 of the Representation of the People Act, 1951, every contesting candidate at an 
election shall, within 30 days from the date of election of the returned candidate, lodge with the District Election 
Officer an account of his/her election expenses which shall be a true copy of the account kept by him/her or his/her 
election agent under Section 77 of the said act; and 


WHEREAS, the result of the election for 03- Khadoor Sahib Parliamentary Constituency of Punjab, 2024 
was declared by the Returning Officer on 047 June, 2024 and hence the last date for lodging the account of Election 
Expenses was 4" July, 2024; and 


WHEREAS, as per the report dated 04.07.2024 of DEO, Tarn Taran under sub-rule (1) of Rule 89 of the 
Conduct of Elections Rules, 1961 received through the CEO, Punjab vide his letter no. Elec-2024/R-7458, dated 
22.07.2024 stating that Sh. Sarabjit Singh, a contesting candidate from 03- Khadoor Sahib Parliamentary 
Constituency of state of Punjab has failed to lodge the account of his election expenses, as required under law; and 


WHEREAS, on the basis of the said report of the District Election Officer, a ‘Show-Cause Notice’ No. 76/PB- 
LS/3/2024/CEMS-I, dated 317 January, 2025 was issued under sub rule (5) of Rule 89 of the Conduct of Elections 
Rules, 1961 by the Election Commission of India to Sh. Sarabjit Singh, for not lodging of the account of Election 
Expenses; and 


WHEREAS, through the above said ‘Show Cause Notice’ and under sub rule (6) of Rule 89 of the Conduct of 
Elections Rules, 1961, Sh. Sarabjit Singh was directed to submit representation in writing to the Commission 
explaining the reasons for not lodging the account and also to lodge the account of his election expenses with the 
District Election Officer, Tarn Taran District within 20 days from the date of receipt of the notice; and 


WHEREAS, the DEO, Tarn Taran has reported that the said ‘Show Cause Notice’ was served to Smt. 
Jasbir Kaur (Mother of Sh. Sarabjit Singh) on 21.11.2025; and 


WHEREAS, the District Election Officer, Tarn Taran in his Supplementary Report, received through the 
CEO, Punjab vide his letter no. Elec-2026/R-1265, dated 17.02.2026 has reported that Sh. Sarabjit Singh has not 
submitted any representation or statement of account of election expenses. Further, after receipt of the said notice, Sh. 
Sarabjit Singh has neither furnished any reason nor explanation to the Election Commission of India for failure to 
lodge the account of his election expenses as prescribed under law; and 


WHEREAS, Section 10A of the Representation of the People Act, 1951 provides that:- 
“If the Election Commission is satisfied that a person- 


(a) has failed to lodge an account of election expenses within the time and in the manner required by or 
under this Act, and 


(b) has no good reason or justification for the failure, 


the Election Commission shall, by order published in the Official Gazette, declare him to be disqualified and any such 
person shall be disqualified for a period of three years from the date of the order.’’; 


WHEREAS, on basis of the facts and available records, the Commission is satisfied that Sh. Sarabjit Singh 
has failed to lodge the account of his election expenses and has no good reason or justification for the failure to do so; 
and 


NOW, THEREFORE, in pursuance of Section 10A of the Representation of the People Act, 1951, the

Punjab, to be disqualified for being chosen as and for being a member of either House of the Parliament or the 
Legislative Assembly or the Legislative Council of a State or Union Territory for a period of three years from the date 
of this order.

LS/3/2024/CEMS-I, dated 317 January, 2025 was issued under sub rule (5) of Rule 89 of the Conduct of Elections 
Rules, 1961 by the Election Commission of India to Sh. Sarabjit Singh, for not lodging of the account of Election 
Expenses; and 


WHEREAS, through the above said ‘Show Cause Notice’ and under sub rule (6) of Rule 89 of the Conduct of 
Elections Rules, 1961, Sh. Sarabjit Singh was directed to submit representation in writing to the Commission 
explaining the reasons for not lodging the account and also to lodge the account of his election expenses with the 
District Election Officer, Tarn Taran District within 20 days from the date of receipt of the notice; and

Jasbir Kaur (Mother of Sh. Sarabjit Singh) on 21.11.2025; and

submitted any representation or statement of account of election expenses. Further, after receipt of the said notice, Sh. 
Sarabjit Singh has neither furnished any reason nor explanation to the Election Commission of India for failure to 
lodge the account of his election expenses as prescribed under law; and 


WHEREAS, Section 10A of the Representation of the People Act, 1951 provides that: - 
“Tf the Election Commission is satisfied that a person- 


(a) has failed to lodge an account of election expenses within the time and in the manner required by or

the Election Commission shall, by order published in the Official Gazette, declare him to be disqualified and any such

ORDER 
New Delhi, the 17th November, 2025 


O.N. 14.—WHEREAS, the General Election to Lok Sabha of Assam, 2024, for 02- Dhubri Parliamentary 
Constituency was held in pursuance of the Election Commission of India Notification No. 464/EPS/2024(3), 
dated 12" April, 2024; and 


WHEREAS, as per Section 78 of the Representation of the People Act, 1951, every contesting candidate at an 
election shall, within 30 days from the date of election of the returned candidate, lodge with the District Election 
Officer an account of his/her election expenses which shall be a true copy of the account kept by him/her or his/her 
election agent under Section 77 of the said act; and 


WHEREAS, the result of the election for 02- Dhubri Parliamentary Constituency of Assam, 2024 was 
declared by the Returning Officer on 047 June, 2024 and hence the last date for lodging the account of Election 
Expenses was 4" July, 2024; and 


WHEREAS, as per the report dated 16.08.2024 of DEO, Dhubri under sub-rule (1) of Rule 89 of the Conduct 
of Elections Rules, 1961 received through the CEO, Assam vide his letter no. ELE.64/2023/496, dated 21.08.2024 
stating that Sh. Shukur Ali, a contesting candidate from 02- Dhubri Parliamentary Constituency of state of Assam 
has failed to lodge the account of his election expenses, as required under law; and 


WHEREAS, on the basis of the said report of the District Election Officer, a ‘Show-Cause Notice’ No. 
76/AS-LS/02/2024/CEMS-I, dated 307 December, 2024 was issued under sub rule (5) of Rule 89 of the Conduct of 
Elections Rules, 1961 by the Election Commission of India to Sh. Shukur Ali, for not lodging of the account of 
Election Expenses; and 


WHEREAS, through the above said ‘Show Cause Notice’ and under sub rule (6) of Rule 89 of the Conduct of 
Elections Rules, 1961, Sh. Shukur Ali was directed to submit representation in writing to the Commission explaining 
the reasons for not lodging the account and also to lodge the account of his election expenses with the District 
Election Officer, Dhubri District within 20 days from the date of receipt of the notice; and 


WHEREAS, the DEO, Dhubri has reported that the said ‘Show Cause Notice’ was served to Sh. Ashaful 
(Brother of Shukur Ali) on 15.01.2025; and 


WHEREAS, the District Election Officer, Dhubri in his Supplementary Report, received through the CEO, 
Assam vide his letter no. ELE.64/2023/Vol-I/19, dated 20.09.2025 has reported that Sh. Shukur Ali has not 
submitted any representation or statement of account of election expenses. Further, after receipt of the said notice, 
Sh. Shukur Ali has neither furnished any reason nor explanation to the Election Commission of India for failure to 
lodge the account of his election expenses as prescribed under law; and 


WHEREAS, Section 10A of the Representation of the People Act, 1951 provides that: - 
“If the Election Commission is satisfied that a person- 


(a) has failed to lodge an account of election expenses within the time and in the manner required by or under this 
Act, and 


(b) has no good reason or justification for the failure, 


the Election Commission shall, by order published in the Official Gazette, declare him to be disqualified and any such 
person Shall be disqualified for a period of three years from the date of the order.”’; 


WHEREAS, on basis of the facts and available records, the Commission is satisfied that Sh. Shukur Ali has 
failed to lodge the account of his election expenses and has no good reason or justification for the failure to do so; and

Parliamentary Constituency of state of Assam, to be disqualified for being chosen as and for being a member of either 
House of the Parliament or the Legislative Assembly or the Legislative Council of a State or Union Territory for a 
period of three years from the date of this order.

O.N. 15.—WHEREAS, the General Election to Lok Sabha of Assam, 2024, for 02- Dhubri Parliamentary 
Constituency was held in pursuance of the Election Commission of India Notification No. 464/EPS/2024(3), dated 
12" April, 2024; and 


WHEREAS, as per Section 78 of the Representation of the People Act, 1951, every contesting candidate at an 
election shall, within 30 days from the date of election of the returned candidate, lodge with the District Election 
Officer an account of his/her election expenses which shall be a true copy of the account kept by him/her or his/her 
election agent under Section 77 of the said act; and 


WHEREAS, the result of the election for 02- Dhubri Parliamentary Constituency of Assam, 2024 was 
declared by the Returning Officer on 047 June, 2024 and hence the last date for lodging the account of Election 
Expenses was 4" July, 2024; and 


WHEREAS, as per the report dated 16.08.2024 of DEO, Dhubri under sub-rule (1) of Rule 89 of the Conduct 
of Elections Rules, 1961 received through the CEO, Assam vide his letter no. ELE.64/2023/496, dated 21.08.2024 
stating that Sh. Alakesh Roy, a contesting candidate from 02- Dhubri Parliamentary Constituency of state of Assam 
has failed to lodge the account of his election expenses, as required under law; and 


WHEREAS, on the basis of the said report of the District Election Officer, a ‘Show-Cause Notice’ 
No. 76/AS-LS/02/2024/CEMS-I, dated 307 December, 2024 was issued under sub rule (5) of Rule 89 of the Conduct 
of Elections Rules, 1961 by the Election Commission of India to Sh. Alakesh Roy, for not lodging of the account of 
Election Expenses; and 


WHEREAS, through the above said ‘Show Cause Notice’ and under sub rule (6) of Rule 89 of the Conduct of 
Elections Rules, 1961, Sh. Alakesh Roy was directed to submit representation in writing to the Commission 
explaining the reasons for not lodging the account and also to lodge the account of his election expenses with the 
District Election Officer, Dhubri District within 20 days from the date of receipt of the notice; and

WHEREAS, the DEO, Dhubri has reported that the said ‘Show Cause Notice’ was served to Sh. Alakesh 
Roy on 10.01.2025; and 


WHEREAS, the District Election Officer, Dhubri in his Supplementary Report, received through the CEO, 
Assam vide his letter no. ELE.64/2023/Vol-I/19, dated 20.09.2025 has reported that Sh. Alakesh Roy has not 
submitted any representation or statement of account of election expenses. Further, after receipt of the said notice, Sh. 
Alakesh Roy has neither furnished any reason nor explanation to the Election Commission of India for failure to 
lodge the account of his election expenses as prescribed under law; and 


WHEREAS, Section 10A of the Representation of the People Act, 1951 provides that: - 
“If the Election Commission is satisfied that a person- 


(a) has failed to lodge an account of election expenses within the time and in the manner required by or under this 
Act, and 


(b) has no good reason or justification for the failure, 


the Election Commission shall, by order published in the Official Gazette, declare him to be disqualified and any such 
person shall be disqualified for a period of three years from the date of the order.’’; 


WHEREAS, on basis of the facts and available records, the Commission is satisfied that Sh. Alakesh Roy has 
failed to lodge the account of his election expenses and has no good reason or justification for the failure to do so; and 


NOW, THEREFORE, in pursuance of Section 10A of the Representation of the People Act, 1951, the 
Election Commission of India hereby declares Sh. Alakesh Roy, resident of Vill- Uttar Raipur Pt.II, P.O. 
Moterjhar, P.S. Golakganj, Dist. Dhubri, Assam, Pin-783334 and a contesting candidate from 02- Dhubri 
Parliamentary Constituency of state of Assam, to be disqualified for being chosen as and for being a member of either 
House of the Parliament or the Legislative Assembly or the Legislative Council of a State or Union Territory for a 
period of three years from the date of this order. 


[F. No. 76/AS-LS/02/2024/CEMS-I]

दिनांक 16.08.2024 की रिपोर्ट के अनुसार, सुश्री राधारानी विश्वास, जो असम के 02-धुबरी संसदीय निर्वाचन क्षेत्र से

उप-नियम (6) के अंतर्गत, सुश्री राधारानी विश्वास को लेखा दाखिल न किए जाने संबंधी कारणों को स्पष्ट करते हुए 
आयोग को अपना अभ्यावेदन लिखित रूप में प्रस्तुत करने और नोटिस के प्राप्त होने की तारीख से 20 दिनों के भीतर जिला

यत:, मुख्य निर्वाचन अधिकारी, असम से उनके दिनांक 20.09.2025 के पत्र सं. 5/ 5.64/2023/४0-॥19, के 
तहत प्राप्त जिला निर्वाचन अधिकारी, धुबरी की अनुपूरक रिपोर्ट के द्वारा सूचित किया है कि सुश्री राधारानी विश्वास ने 
निर्वाचन व्यय के लेखे का कोई विवरण प्रस्तुत नहीं किया है। इसके अतिरिक्त, उक्त नोटिस मिलने के उपरांत, 
सुश्री राधारानी विश्वास द्वारा विधि के अंतर्गत यथा-विहित लेखे दाखिल करने में अपनी असफलता के लिए भारत निर्वाचन 
आयोग को न तो कोई कारण बताया है और न ही कोई स्पष्टीकरण दिया है; और 


यत:, लोक प्रतिनिधित्व अधिनियम, 1951 की धारा 10क में यह उपबंधित किया गया है कि:- 
“यदि निवाचिित आयोग का सयाधान हो जाता है कि कोई व्यक्ति-

है, दाखिल करने यें असफल CET है; तथा 
(व) उस असफलता के लिए कोई अच्छा कारण या न्यायोचित्य नहीं रखता है; 


तो निर्वाचन आयोग शासकीय राजपत्र में प्रकाशित आदेश द्वारा उसको PAST घोषित करेगा और ऐसा व्यक्ति उस 
आदेश की तारीख से तीन वर्ष की कालावधि के लिए freer होया। 


यत:, तथ्यों और उपलब्ध रिकार्डों के आधार पर, आयोग का यह समाधान हो गया है कि सुश्री राधारानी विश्वास 
अपने निर्वाचन व्यय के लेखे दाखिल करने में असफल रही हैं और उनके पास ऐसा करने में असफल रहने के लिए कोई भी 
उचित कारण अथवा औचित्य नहीं है; और 
अत:, अब, लोक प्रतिनिधित्व अधिनियम, 1951 की धारा 10क के अनुसरण में, भारत निर्वाचन आयोग एतद्दारा

इस आदेश की तारीख से तीन वर्ष की अवधि के लिए संसद के किसी भी सदन अथवा राज्य अथवा संघ राज्य क्षेत्र की

New Delhi, the 17th November, 2025 


O.N. 17.—WHEREAS, the General Election to Lok Sabha of Punjab, 2024, for 06- Anandpur Sahib 
Parliamentary Constituency was held in pursuance of the Election Commission of India Notification 
No. 464/EPS/2024(7), dated 7 May, 2024; and 


WHEREAS, as per Section 78 of the Representation of the People Act, 1951, every contesting candidate at an 
election shall, within 30 days from the date of election of the returned candidate, lodge with the District Election 
Officer an account of his/her election expenses which shall be a true copy of the account kept by him/her or his/her 
election agent under Section 77 of the said act; and 

WHEREAS, the result of the election for 06- Anandpur Sahib Parliamentary Constituency of Punjab, 2024 
was declared by the Returning Officer on 04" June, 2024 and hence the last date for lodging the account of Election 
Expenses was 4" July, 2024; and 

WHEREAS, as per the report dated 05.07.2024 of DEO, Rupnagar under sub-rule (1) of Rule 89 of the 
Conduct of Elections Rules, 1961 received through the CEO, Punjab vide his letter no. Elec-2024/R-7458, dated 
22.07.2024 stating that Sh. Satpal, a contesting candidate from 06-Anandpur Sahib Parliamentary Constituency of 
state of Punjab has failed to lodge the account of his election expenses, as required under law; and 

WHEREAS, on the basis of the said report of the District Election Officer, a ‘Show-Cause Notice’ No. 76/PB- 
LS/06/2024/CEMS-I, dated 31 January, 2025 was issued under sub rule (5) of Rule 89 of the Conduct of Elections 
Rules, 1961 by the Election Commission of India to Sh. Satpal, for not lodging of the account of Election Expenses; 
and 

WHEREAS, through the above said ‘Show Cause Notice’ and under sub rule (6) of Rule 89 of the Conduct of 
Elections Rules, 1961, Sh. Satpal was directed to submit representation in writing to the Commission explaining the 
reasons for not lodging the account and also to lodge the account of his election expenses with the District Election 
Officer, Rupnagar District within 20 days from the date of receipt of the notice; and 

WHEREAS, the DEO, Rupnagar has reported that the said ‘Show Cause Notice’ was served to Sh. Satpal 
on 03.02.2025; and 


WHEREAS, the District Election Officer, Rupnagar in his Supplementary Report no. Elec.2025/783; dated 
14.08.2025 has reported that Sh. Satpal has not submitted any representation or statement of account of election 
expenses. Further, after receipt of the said notice, Sh. Satpal has neither furnished any reason nor explanation to the 
Election Commission of India for failure to lodge the account of his election expenses as prescribed under law; and 


WHEREAS, Section 10A of the Representation of the People Act, 1951 provides that: - 
“Tf the Election Commission is satisfied that a person- 


(a) has failed to lodge an account of election expenses within the time and in the manner required by or under this 
Act, and 


(b) has no good reason or justification for the failure,

the Election Commission shall, by order published in the Official Gazette, declare him to be disqualified and any such 
person shall be disqualified for a period of three years from the date of the order.”’; 


WHEREAS, on basis of the facts and available records, the Commission is satisfied that Sh. Satpal has failed 
to lodge the account of his election expenses and has no good reason or justification for the failure to do so; and 


NOW, THEREFORE, in pursuance of Section 10A of the Representation of the People Act, 1951, the 
Election Commission of India hereby declares Sh. Satpal, resident of Vill- Chankoi, P.O. Gulpur, Tehsil 
Balachaur, Dist. SBS Nagar/Nawanshahr, Punjab and a contesting candidate from 06- Anandpur Sahib 
Parliamentary Constituency of State of Punjab, to be disqualified for being chosen as and for being a member of 
either House of the Parliament or the Legislative Assembly or the Legislative Council of a State or Union Territory 
for a period of three years from the date of this order.

ORDER 
New Delhi, the 20th November, 2025 


O.N. 19.—WHEREAS, the General Election to Lok Sabha of Punjab, 2024, for 07- Ludhiana Parliamentary 
Constituency was held in pursuance of the Election Commission of India Notification No. 464/EPS/2024(7), 
dated 77 May, 2024; and 


WHEREAS, as per Section 78 of the Representation of the People Act, 1951, every contesting candidate at an 
election shall, within 30 days from the date of election of the returned candidate, lodge with the District Election 
Officer an account of his/her election expenses which shall be a true copy of the account kept by him/her or his/her 
election agent under Section 77 of the said act; and 


WHEREAS, the result of the election for 07- Ludhiana Parliamentary Constituency of Punjab, 2024 was 
declared by the Returning Officer on 04" June, 2024 and hence the last date for lodging the account of Election 
Expenses was 4" July, 2024; and 


WHEREAS, as per the report dated 05.07.2024 of DEO, Ludhiana under sub-rule (1) of Rule 89 of the 
Conduct of Elections Rules, 1961 received through the CEO, Punjab vide his letter no. Elec-2024/R-7458, dated 
22.07.2024 stating that Sh. Amritpal Singh Chhandran, a contesting candidate from 07- Ludhiana Parliamentary 
Constituency of state of Punjab has failed to lodge the account of his election expenses, as required under law; and 


WHEREAS, on the basis of the said report of the District Election Officer, a ‘Show-Cause Notice’ No. 76/PB- 
LS/07/2024/CEMS-I, dated 06" February, 2025 was issued under sub rule (5) of Rule 89 of the Conduct of Elections 
Rules, 1961 by the Election Commission of India to Sh. Amritpal Singh Chhandran, for not lodging of the account 
of Election Expenses; and 


WHEREAS, through the above said ‘Show Cause Notice’ and under sub rule (6) of Rule 89 of the Conduct of 
Elections Rules, 1961, Sh. Amritpal Singh Chhandran was directed to submit representation in writing to the 
Commission explaining the reasons for not lodging the account and also to lodge the account of his election expenses 
with the District Election Officer, Ludhiana District within 20 days from the date of receipt of the notice; and 


WHEREAS, the DEO, Ludhiana has reported that the said ‘Show Cause Notice’ was served to Sh. Amritpal 
Singh Chhandran on 13.02.2025; and 


WHEREAS, the District Election Officer, Ludhiana in his Supplementary Report, received through the CEO, 
Punjab vide his letter no. Elec-2025/R-1601, dated 07.04.2025 has reported that Sh. Amritpal Singh Chhandran has 
not submitted any representation or statement of account of election expenses. Further, after receipt of the said notice, 
Sh. Amritpal Singh Chhandran has neither furnished any reason nor explanation to the Election Commission of 
India for failure to lodge the account of his election expenses as prescribed under law; and 


WHEREAS, Section 10A of the Representation of the People Act, 1951 provides that:- 
“If the Election Commission is satisfied that a person- 


(a) has failed to lodge an account of election expenses within the time and in the manner required by or under this 
Act, and 


(b) has no good reason or justification for the failure, 


the Election Commission shall, by order published in the Official Gazette, declare him to be disqualified and any such 
person shall be disqualified for a period of three years from the date of the order.’’; 


WHEREAS, on basis of the facts and available records, the Commission is satisfied that Sh. Amritpal Singh 
Chhandran has failed to lodge the account of his election expenses and has no good reason or justification for the 
failure to do so; and 


NOW, THEREFORE, in pursuance of Section 10A of the Representation of the People Act, 1951, the 
Election Commission of India hereby declares Sh. Amritpal Singh Chhandran, resident of H.No. 613, Azad Nagar, 
Patiala, Punjab, Pin-147001 and a contesting candidate from 07- Ludhiana Parliamentary Constituency of State of 
Punjab, to be disqualified for being chosen as and for being a member of either House of the Parliament or the 
Legislative Assembly or the Legislative Council of a State or Union Territory for a period of three years from the date 
of this order.

May, 2024; and 


WHEREAS, as per Section 78 of the Representation of the People Act, 1951, every contesting candidate at an

WHEREAS, the result of the election for 07- Ludhiana Parliamentary Constituency of Punjab, 2024 was

Expenses was 4" July, 2024; and 


WHEREAS, as per the report dated 04.07.2024 of DEO, Ludhiana under sub-rule (1) of Rule 89 of the 
Conduct of Elections Rules, 1961 received through the CEO, Punjab vide his letter no. Elec-2024/R-7458, dated 
22.07.2024 stating that Sh. Chandi, a contesting candidate from 07- Ludhiana Parliamentary Constituency of state 
of Punjab has failed to lodge the account of his election expenses, as required under law; and 


WHEREAS, on the basis of the said report of the District Election Officer, a ‘Show-Cause Notice’ No. 76/PB- 
LS/07/2024/CEMS-I, dated 06" February, 2025 was issued under sub rule (5) of Rule 89 of the Conduct of Elections 
Rules, 1961 by the Election Commission of India to Sh. Chandi, for not lodging of the account of Election Expenses; 
and 


WHEREAS, through the above said ‘Show Cause Notice’ and under sub rule (6) of Rule 89 of the Conduct of 
Elections Rules, 1961, Sh. Chandi was directed to submit representation in writing to the Commission explaining the 
reasons for not lodging the account and also to lodge the account of his election expenses with the District Election 
Officer, Ludhiana District within 20 days from the date of receipt of the notice; and 


WHEREAS, the DEO, Ludhiana has reported that the said ‘Show Cause Notice’ was served to Sh. Chandi

Punjab vide his letter no. Elec-2025/R-1601, dated 07.04.2025 has reported that Sh. Chandi has not submitted any 
representation or statement of account of election expenses. Further, after receipt of the said notice, Sh. Chandi has 
neither furnished any reason nor explanation to the Election Commission of India for failure to lodge the account of 
his election expenses as prescribed under law; and 


WHEREAS, Section 10A of the Representation of the People Act, 1951 provides that:-

“If the Election Commission is satisfied that a person-

ORDER 
New Delhi, the 21st November, 2025 


O.N. 22.—WHEREAS, the General Election to Lok Sabha of Haryana, 2024 for 10-Faridabad 
Parliamentary Constituency was held in pursuance of the Election Commission of India Notification No. O.N. 114(E), 
dated 29" April, 2024; and 


WHEREAS, as per Section 78 of the Representation of the People Act, 1951, every contesting candidate at an 
election shall, within 30 days from the date of election of the returned candidate, lodge with the District Election 
Officer an account of his/her election expenses which shall be true copy of the account kept by him/her or his/her 
election agent under Section 77 of the said act; and 


WHEREAS, the result of the above-mentioned election for 10-Faridabad Parliamentary Constituency of 
Haryana, 2024 was declared by the Returning Officer on 47 June, 2024 and hence the last date for lodging the 
account of Election Expenses was 47 July, 2024; and 


WHEREAS, as per the report submitted by DEO, Faridabad dated 30.07.2024 forwarded by the Chief 
Electoral Officer, Haryana vide his letter no. 6/Elect-Exp./GEL-2024/2AE-7497, dated 05.08.2024, under sub-rule (1) 
of Rule 89 of the Conduct of Elections Rules, 1961, Sh. Gyan Chand Bainsla a contesting candidate from 10- 
Faridabad Parliamentary Constituency of state of Haryana has failed to lodge account of election expenses, as 
required under law; and 


WHEREAS, on the basis of the said report of the District Election Officer, Faridabad a Show-Cause notice 
No. 76/HR-LS/10/2024/CEMS-I, dated 207 December, 2024 was issued under sub rule (5) of Rule 89 of the 
Conduct of Elections Rules, 1961 by the Election Commission of India to Sh. Gyan Chand Bainsla for not lodging 
of his account of Election Expenses; and 


WHEREAS, through the above said Show Cause Notice and under sub rule (6) of Rule 89 of the Conduct of 
Elections Rules, 1961, Sh. Gyan Chand Bainsla was directed to submit representation in writing to the Commission 
explaining the reasons for not lodging the account and also to lodge account of election expenses with the District 
Election Officer, Faridabad within 20 days from the date of receipt of the notice; and 


WHEREAS, the District Election Officer, Faridabad vide his letter no. Election-2025/229 dated 05.02.2025 
has informed that the notice was duly served and received by Sh. Gyan Chand Bainsla on 04.01.2025; and 


WHEREAS, the District Election Officer, Faridabad in his Supplementary Report, vide its letter no. Election- 
2025/663 dated 07.04.2025 has reported that Sh. Gyan Chand Bainsla has not submitted account of election 
expenses. Further, after receipt of the said notice, Sh. Gyan Chand Bainsla has neither furnished any reason nor 
explanation to the Election Commission of India, for failure to lodge the account of his election expenses as 
prescribed under law; and 


WHEREAS, Section 10 A of the Representation of the People Act, 1951 provides that:- 
“If the Election Commission is satisfied that a person- 


(a) has failed to lodge an account of election expenses, within the time and in the manner required by or under 
this Act, and 


[भाग 1---खण्ड 3(iii)] भारत का राजपत्र : मई 16, 2026/वैशाख 26, 1948 57 


(b) has no good reason or justification for the failure, the Election Commission shall, by order published in the 
Official Gazette, declare him to be disqualified and any such person shall be disqualified for a period of three years 
from the date of the order.”’; 


WHEREAS, on the basis of facts and available records, the Commission is satisfied that Sh. Gyan Chand Bainsla 
has failed to lodge account of his election expenses and has no good reason or justification for the failure to do so; and 


NOW, THEREFORE, in pursuance of Section 10A of the Representation of the People Act, 1951, the Election 
Commission of India hereby declares Sh. Gyan Chand Bainsla, Near Sarkari School, Kamrawali, Barauli(149) 
Baroli, Palwal, Haryana-121102, a contesting candidate for 10-Faridabad Parliamentary Constituency of 
Haryana in General Election to Lok Sabha, 2024 to be disqualified for being chosen as and for being a member of 
either House of the Parliament or the Legislative Assembly or the Legislative Council of a State or Union Territory 
for a period of three years from the date of this order.

New Delhi, the 24th November, 2025 


O.N. 26.—WHEREAS, the General Election to Lok Sabha of Kerala, 2024 for 10-Thrissur Parliamentary 
Constituency was held in pursuance of the Election Commission of India Notification No. O.N. 92(E), dated 
28" March, 2024; and 


WHEREAS, as per Section 78 of the Representation of the People Act, 1951, every contesting candidate at an 
election shall, within 30 days from the date of election of the returned candidate, lodge with the District Election 
Officer an account of his/her election expenses which shall be a true copy of the account kept by him/her or his/her 
election agent under Section 77 of the said act; and 


WHEREAS, the result of the election for 10-Thrissur Parliamentary Constituency of Kerala, 2024 was 
declared by the Returning Officer on 047 June, 2024 and hence the last date for lodging the account of Election 
Expenses was 04" July, 2024; and 


WHEREAS, as per the report dated 05.07.2024 of District Election Officer, Thrissur under sub-rule (1) of 
Rule 89 of the Conduct of Elections Rules, 1961 received through the Chief Electoral Officer, Kerala vide his letter 
no. EL1/113/2024-ELEC; dated 31.07.2024 stating that Sh. M. S. Jafarghan, a contesting candidate from 
10-Thrissur Parliamentary Constituency in General Election to Lok Sabha of Kerala, 2024, has failed to lodge the 
account of his election expenses, as required under law; and 


WHEREAS, on basis of the said report of the District Election Officer, Thrissur a Show-Cause Notice no. 
76/KL-PC/2024/CEMS-II, dated 29" August, 2024 was issued under sub rule (5) of Rule 89 of the Conduct of 
Elections Rules, 1961 by the Election Commission of India to Sh. M. S. Jafarghan, for not lodging of the account of 
Election Expenses; and 


WHEREAS, through the above said Show Cause Notice and under sub rule (6) of Rule 89 of the Conduct of 
Elections Rules, 1961, Sh. M. S. Jafarghan was directed to submit representation in writing to the Commission 
explaining the reasons for not lodging the account and also to lodge the account of his election expenses with the 
District Election Officer, Thrissur District within 20 days from the date of receipt of the notice; and 


WHEREAS, the District Election Officer, Thrissur through Chief Electoral Officer, Kerala in his report no. 
EL1/113/2024-ELEC; dated 21.01.2025 has reported that the said Show Cause Notice was Served to 
Sh. M. S. Jafarghan on 09.09.2024; and 


WHEREAS, the District Election Officer, Thrissur in his Supplementary Report dated 05.10.2024 and 
26.09.2025 on account of the candidate received through Chief Electoral Officer, Kerala letter no. EL1/113/2024- 
ELEC; dated 21.01.2025 and 08.10.2025 has reported that Sh. M. S. Jafarghan has not submitted any representation 
or statement of the account of election expenses. Further, after receipt of the said notice, Sh. M. S. Jafarghan has 
neither furnished any reason nor explanation to the Election Commission of India for failure to lodge the account of 
his election expenses as prescribed under law; and 


WHEREAS, Section 10A of the Representation of the People Act, 1951 provides that: - 
“If the Election Commission is satisfied that a person- 
(e) has failed to lodge an account of election expenses within the time and in the manner required by or under this 
Act, and 
(f) has no good reason or justification for the failure, 


the Election Commission shall, by order published in the Official Gazette, declare him to be disqualified and any such 


, 


person shall be disqualified for a period of three years from the date of the order.”’; 


WHEREAS, on basis of the facts and available records, the Commission is satisfied that Sh. M. S. Jafarghan 
has failed to lodge the account of his election expenses and has no good reason or justification for the failure to do so; 
and 


NOW, THEREFORE, in pursuance of Section 10A of the Representation of the People Act, 1951, the 
Election Commission of India hereby declares Sh. M. S. Jafarghan, resident of Munnakkaparambil House, 
Ponjanam P O, Kattoor, Thrissur, Pin-680702 and a contesting candidate from 10-Thrissur Parliamentary 
Constituency of Kerala in General Election to the Lok Sabha, 2024, to be disqualified for being chosen as and for 
being a member of either House of the Parliament or the Legislative Assembly or the Legislative Council of a State or 
Union Territory for a period of three years from the date of this order.

ORDER 
New Delhi, the 27th November, 2025 


O.N. 29.—WHEREAS, the General Election to Legislative Assembly of Haryana, 2024 for 73-Kosli 
Assembly Constituency was held in pursuance of the Election Commission of India Notification No. 464/ECI/HAR- 
LA/2024, dated 5° September, 2024; and 


WHEREAS, as per Section 78 of the Representation of the People Act, 1951, every contesting candidate at an 
election shall, within 30 days from the date of election of the returned candidate, lodge with the District Election 
Officer an account of his/her election expenses which shall be true copy of the account kept by him/her or his/her 
election agent under Section 77 of the said act; and 


WHEREAS, the result of the above-mentioned election from 73-Kosli Assembly Constituency of Haryana, 
was declared by the Returning Officer on 8" October, 2024 and hence the last date for lodging the account of 
Election Expenses was 77 November, 2024; and 


WHEREAS, as per the report submitted by DEO, Rewari forwarded by the Chief Electoral Officer, Haryana 
vide his letter no. 6/Elect-Exp./GELA-HR-2024/Elec-2025/2AE-692 dated 05.02.2025, under sub-rule (1) of Rule 89 
of the Conduct of Elections Rules, 1961, Sh. Lavinder Singh a contesting candidate from 73-Kosli Assembly 
Constituency has failed to lodge account of election expenses, as required under law; and 


WHEREAS, on the basis of the said report of the District Election Officer, Rewari a Show-Cause notice 
No. 76/HR-LA/Exp. Account/2024/CEMS-I, dated 30" April, 2025 was issued under sub rule (5) of Rule 89 of the 
Conduct of Elections Rules, 1961 by the Election Commission of India to Sh. Lavinder Singh for not lodging of his 
account of Election Expenses; and 


WHEREAS, through the above said Show Cause Notice and under sub rule (6) of Rule 89 of the Conduct of 
Elections Rules, 1961, Sh. Lavinder Singh was directed to submit representation in writing to the Commission 
explaining the reasons for not lodging the account and also to lodge account of election expenses with the District 
Election Officer, Rewari within 20 days from the date of receipt of the notice; and 


WHEREAS, the District Election Officer, Rewari vide his letter no. Elec-2025/711 dated 16.06.2025 has 
informed that the notice was duly served and received by Sh. Lavinder Singh on 20.05.2025; and 


WHEREAS, the District Election Officer, Rewari in his Supplementary Report, vide its letter no. Elec- 
2025/711 dated 16.06.2025 has reported that Sh. Lavinder Singh has not submitted account of election expenses. 
Further, after receipt of the said notice, Sh. Lavinder Singh has neither furnished any reason nor explanation to the 
Election Commission of India, for failure to lodge the account of his election expenses as prescribed under law; and 


WHEREAS, Section 10 A of the Representation of the People Act, 1951 provides that:- 
“If the Election Commission is satisfied that a person- 


(a) has failed to lodge an account of election expenses, within the time and in the manner required by or under 
this Act, and 


(b) has no good reason or justification for the failure, the Election Commission shall, by order published in the 
Official Gazette, declare him to be disqualified and any such person shall be disqualified for a period of three years 
from the date of the order.”’;

WHEREAS, on the basis of facts and available records, the Commission is satisfied that Sh. Lavinder Singh 
has failed to lodge account of his election expenses and has no good reason or justification for the failure to do so; and 


NOW, THEREFORE, in pursuance of Section 10A of the Representation of the People Act, 1951, the 
Election Commission of India hereby declares Sh. Lavinder Singh, House No. 985, Village Kanwali, District 
Rewari, Haryana, a contesting candidate from 73-Kosli Assembly Constituency of Haryana in General Election to 
Legislative Assembly, 2024 to be disqualified for being chosen as and for being a member of either House of the 
Parliament or the Legislative Assembly or the Legislative Council of a State or Union Territory for a period of three 
years from the date of this order.

ORDER 
New Delhi, the 27th November, 2025 


O.N. 30.—WHEREAS, the General Election to Legislative Assembly of Haryana, 2024 for 73-Kosli 
Assembly Constituency was held in pursuance of the Election Commission of India Notification No. 464/ECI/HAR- 
LA/2024, dated 5h September, 2024; and 


WHEREAS, as per Section 78 of the Representation of the People Act, 1951, every contesting candidate at an 
election shall, within 30 days from the date of election of the returned candidate, lodge with the District Election 
Officer an account of his/her election expenses which shall be true copy of the account kept by him/her or his/her 
election agent under Section 77 of the said act; and 


WHEREAS, the result of the above-mentioned election from 73-Kosli Assembly Constituency of Haryana, 
was declared by the Returning Officer on 8" October, 2024 and hence the last date for lodging the account of 
Election Expenses was 77 November, 2024; and 


WHEREAS, as per the report submitted by DEO, Rewari forwarded by the Chief Electoral Officer, 
Haryana vide his letter no. 6/Elect-Exp./GELA-HR-2024/Elec-2025/2AE-692 dated 05.02.2025, under sub-rule (1) of 
Rule 89 of the Conduct of Elections Rules, 1961, Sh. Naval Singh a contesting candidate from 73-Kosli Assembly 
Constituency has failed to lodge account of election expenses, as required under law; and 


WHEREAS, on the basis of the said report of the District Election Officer, Rewari a Show-Cause notice 
No. 76/HR-LA/Exp. Account/2024/CEMS-I, dated 30" April, 2025 was issued under sub rule (5) of Rule 89 of the 
Conduct of Elections Rules, 1961 by the Election Commission of India to Sh. Naval Singh for not lodging of his 
account of Election Expenses; and 


[भाग 1---खण्ड 3(iii)] भारत का राजपत्र : मई 16, 2026/वैशाख 26, 1948 प्रा 


WHEREAS, through the above said Show Cause Notice and under sub rule (6) of Rule 89 of the Conduct of 
Elections Rules, 1961, Sh. Naval Singh was directed to submit representation in writing to the Commission 
explaining the reasons for not lodging the account and also to lodge account of election expenses with the District 
Election Officer, Rewari within 20 days from the date of receipt of the notice; and 


WHEREAS, the District Election Officer, Rewari vide his letter no. Elec-2025/711 dated 16.06.2025 has 
informed that the notice was duly served and received by Sh. Naval Singh on 20.05.2025; and 


WHEREAS, the District Election Officer, Rewari in his Supplementary Report, vide its letter no. Elec- 
2025/711 dated 16.06.2025 has reported that Sh. Naval Singh has not submitted account of election expenses. 
Further, after receipt of the said notice, Sh. Naval Singh has neither furnished any reason nor explanation to the 
Election Commission of India, for failure to lodge the account of his election expenses as prescribed under law; and 


WHEREAS, Section 10 A of the Representation of the People Act, 1951 provides that:- 
“If the Election Commission is satisfied that a person- 


(a) has failed to lodge an account of election expenses, within the time and in the manner required by or under 
this Act, and 


(b) has no good reason or justification for the failure, the Election Commission shall, by order published in the 
Official Gazette, declare him to be disqualified and any such person shall be disqualified for a period of three years 
from the date of the order.”’; 


WHEREAS, on the basis of facts and available records, the Commission is satisfied that Sh. Naval Singh 
has failed to lodge account of his election expenses and has no good reason or justification for the failure to do so; and 


NOW, THEREFORE, in pursuance of Section 10A of the Representation of the People Act, 1951, the 
Election Commission of India hereby declares Sh. Naval Singh, House No. 89, Village Mandiya Khurd, Tehsil 
and District Rewari, Haryana, a contesting candidate from 73-Kosli Assembly Constituency of Haryana in 
General Election to Legislative Assembly, 2024 to be disqualified for being chosen as and for being a member of 
either House of the Parliament or the Legislative Assembly or the Legislative Council of a State or Union Territory 
for a period of three years from the date of this order. 


[F. No. 76/HR-LA/73/2024/CEMS-I] 
By Order, 
RAKESH KUMAR, Secy.

ORDER 
New Delhi, the 27th November, 2025 


O.N. 31.—WHEREAS, the General Election to Legislative Assembly of Haryana, 2024 for 73-Kosli 
Assembly Constituency was held in pursuance of the Election Commission of India Notification No. 464/ECI/HAR- 
LA/2024, dated 50 September, 2024; and 


WHEREAS, as per Section 78 of the Representation of the People Act, 1951, every contesting candidate at an 
election shall, within 30 days from the date of election of the returned candidate, lodge with the District Election 
Officer an account of his/her election expenses which shall be true copy of the account kept by him/her or his/her 
election agent under Section 77 of the said act; and 


WHEREAS, the result of the above-mentioned election from 73-Kosli Assembly Constituency of Haryana, 
was declared by the Returning Officer on 8" October, 2024 and hence the last date for lodging the account of 
Election Expenses was 77 November, 2024; and 


WHEREAS, as per the report submitted by DEO, Rewari forwarded by the Chief Electoral Officer, Haryana 
vide his letter no. 6/Elect-Exp./GELA-HR-2024/Elec-2025/2AE-692 dated 05.02.2025, under sub-rule (1) of Rule 89 
of the Conduct of Elections Rules, 1961, Sh. Mukesh Kumar a contesting candidate from 73-Kosli Assembly 
Constituency has failed to lodge account of election expenses, as required under law; and 


WHEREAS, on the basis of the said report of the District Election Officer, Rewari a Show-Cause notice No. 
76/HR-LA/Exp. Account/2024/CEMS-I, dated 30™ April, 2025 was issued under sub rule (5) of Rule 89 of the 
Conduct of Elections Rules, 1961 by the Election Commission of India to Sh. Mukesh Kumar for not lodging of his 
account of Election Expenses; and 


WHEREAS, through the above said Show Cause Notice and under sub rule (6) of Rule 89 of the Conduct of 
Elections Rules, 1961, Sh. Mukesh Kumar was directed to submit representation in writing to the Commission 
explaining the reasons for not lodging the account and also to lodge account of election expenses with the District 
Election Officer, Rewari within 20 days from the date of receipt of the notice; and 


WHEREAS, the District Election Officer, Rewari vide his letter no. Elec-2025/711 dated 16.06.2025 has 
informed that the notice was duly served and received by Sh. Mukesh Kumar on 20.05.2025; and 


WHEREAS, the District Election Officer, Rewari in his Supplementary Report, vide its letter no. Elec- 
2025/711 dated 16.06.2025 has reported that Sh. Mukesh Kumar has not submitted account of election expenses. 
Further, after receipt of the said notice, Sh. Mukesh Kumar has neither furnished any reason nor explanation to the 
Election Commission of India, for failure to lodge the account of his election expenses as prescribed under law; and 


WHEREAS, Section 10 A of the Representation of the People Act, 1951 provides that:- 
“If the Election Commission is satisfied that a person- 


(a) has failed to lodge an account of election expenses, within the time and in the manner required by or under 
this Act, and 


(b) has no good reason or justification for the failure, the Election Commission shall, by order published in the 
Official Gazette, declare him to be disqualified and any such person shall be disqualified for a period of three years 
from the date of the order.”’; 


WHEREAS, on the basis of facts and available records, the Commission is satisfied that Sh. Mukesh Kumar 
has failed to lodge account of his election expenses and has no good reason or justification for the failure to do so; and 


NOW, THEREFORE, in pursuance of Section 10A of the Representation of the People Act, 1951, the 
Election Commission of India hereby declares Sh. Mukesh Kumar, VPO Mandola, District Rewari, Haryana, a 
contesting candidate from 73-Kosli Assembly Constituency of Haryana in General Election to Legislative Assembly, 
2024 to be disqualified for being chosen as and for being a member of either House of the Parliament or the 
Legislative Assembly or the Legislative Council of a State or Union Territory for a period of three years from the date 
of this order.

New Delhi, the 28th November, 2025 


O.N. 32.—WHEREAS, the General Election to Legislative Assembly of Haryana, 2024 for 44-Rania 
Assembly Constituency was held in pursuance of the Election Commission of India Notification No. 464/ECI/HAR- 
LA/2024, dated 50 September, 2024; and 


WHEREAS, as per Section 78 of the Representation of the People Act, 1951, every contesting candidate at an 
election shall, within 30 days from the date of election of the returned candidate, lodge with the District Election 
Officer an account of his/her election expenses which shall be true copy of the account kept by him/her or his/her 
election agent under Section 77 of the said act; and 


WHEREAS, the result of the above-mentioned election for 44-Rania Assembly Constituency of Haryana, 
2024 was declared by the Returning Officer on 87 October, 2024 and hence the last date for lodging the account of 
Election Expenses was 77 November, 2024; and 


WHEREAS, as per the report submitted by DEO, Sirsa report dated 08.11.2024 forwarded by the Chief 
Electoral Officer, Haryana vide his letter no. 6/Elect-Exp./GELA-HR-2024/Elec-2025/2AE-692 dated 05.02.2025, 
under sub-rule (1) of Rule 89 of the Conduct of Elections Rules, 1961, Sh. Lucky Balmiki a contesting candidate 
from 44-Rania Assembly Constituency of state of Haryana has failed to lodge account of election expenses, as 
required under law; and 


WHEREAS, on the basis of the said report of the District Election Officer, Sirsa a Show-Cause notice No. 
76/HR-LA/Exp. Account/2024/CEMS-I, dated 30™ April, 2025 was issued under sub rule (5) of Rule 89 of the 
Conduct of Elections Rules, 1961 by the Election Commission of India to Sh. Lucky Balmiki for not lodging of his 
account of Election Expenses; and 


WHEREAS, through the above said Show Cause Notice and under sub rule (6) of Rule 89 of the Conduct of 
Elections Rules, 1961, Sh. Lucky Balmiki was directed to submit representation in writing to the Commission 
explaining the reasons for not lodging the account and also to lodge account of election expenses with the District 
Election Officer, Sirsa within 20 days from the date of receipt of the notice; and 


WHEREAS, the District Election Officer, Sirsa vide his letter no. Elec-2025/321 dated 09.06.2025 has 
informed that the notice was duly served and received by Sh. Lucky Balmiki on 08.05.2025; and 


WHEREAS, the District Election Officer, Sirsa in his Supplementary Report, vide its letter no. Elec- 
2025/550 dated 24.10.2025 has reported that Sh. Lucky Balmiki has not submitted account of election expenses. 


82 THE GAZETTE OF INDIA : MAY 16, 2026/V AISAKHA 26, 1948 [PART II—SEC. 3(iii)] 


Further, after receipt of the said notice, Sh. Lucky Balmiki has neither furnished any reason nor explanation to the 
Election Commission of India, for failure to lodge the account of his election expenses as prescribed under law; and 


WHEREAS, Section 10 A of the Representation of the People Act, 1951 provides that:- 
“If the Election Commission is satisfied that a person- 


(a) has failed to lodge an account of election expenses, within the time and in the manner required by or under 
this Act, and 


(b) has no good reason or justification for the failure, the Election Commission shall, by order published in the 
Official Gazette, declare him to be disqualified and any such person shall be disqualified for a period of three years 
from the date of the order.”’; 


WHEREAS, on the basis of facts and available records, the Commission is satisfied that Sh. Lucky Balmiki 
has failed to lodge account of his election expenses and has no good reason or justification for the failure to do so; and 


NOW, THEREFORE, in pursuance of Section 10A of the Representation of the People Act, 1951, the 
Election Commission of India hereby declares Sh. Lucky Balmiki, House No. 241, Mohalla Kumaharan, Ward 
No. 18, Sirsa, Haryana, a contesting candidate for 44-Rania Assembly Constituency of Haryana in General 
Election to Legislative Assembly, 2024 to be disqualified for being chosen as and for being a member of either House 
of the Parliament or the Legislative Assembly or the Legislative Council of a State or Union Territory for a period of 
three years from the date of this order.

Officer an account of his election expenses which shall be a true copy of the account kept by him or his election agent

condone any incidence of late submission of the account by candidate till 317 July, 2021; and

Conduct of Elections Rules, 1961, received through the Chief Electoral Officer, Kerala vide his letter no. EL1/2/2021- 
ELEC; dated 24.08.2021 stating that Sh. Albin Mathew, a contesting candidate from 101-Poonjar Assembly 
Constituency of Kerala in General Election to the Legislative Assembly, 2021 has failed to lodge his account of 
election expenses, as required under law; and

No. 76/KL-LA/2021/CEMS-II, dated 067" October, 2021 was issued under sub rule (5) of Rule 89 of the Conduct of 
Elections Rules, 1961 by the Election Commission of India to Sh. Albin Mathew, for not lodging the account of 
Election Expenses; and 

WHEREAS, through the above said ‘Show Cause Notice’ and under sub rule (6) of Rule 89 of the Conduct of 
Elections Rules, 1961, Sh. Albin Mathew was directed to submit a representation in writing to the Commission 
explaining the reasons for not lodging the account and also to lodge account of election expenses with the District 
Election Officer, Kottayam within 20 days from the date of receipt of the notice; and 


WHEREAS, the Chief Electoral Officer, Kerala, vide his report no. EL1/2/2021-ELEC dated 30.07.2025, has

the District Election Officer, Kottayam;

forwarded by the Chief Electoral Officer, Kerala vide his letter no. EL1/2/2021-ELEC; dated 30.07.2025 on account 
of the candidate, has reported that Sh. Albin Mathew has not submitted any representation or statement of correct 
account of election expenses. Besides, after receipt of the said notice, Sh. Albin Mathew has neither furnished any 
reason nor explanation to the Election Commission of India, for failure to lodge the account of his election 
expenditure as prescribed under law; and

the Election Commission shall, by order published in the Official Gazette, declare him to be disqualified and any such

Returning Officer on 02" May, 2021 and hence the last date for lodging the account of Election Expenses was 
017 June, 2021; and 


WHEREAS, the Commission having regard to the then prevailing pandemic situation of Covid-19, decided to 
condone any incidence of late submission of the account by candidate till 317 July, 2021; and 


WHEREAS, as per the report of the District Election Officer, Kottayam, under sub-rule (1) of Rule 89 of the 
Conduct of Elections Rules, 1961, received through the Chief Electoral Officer, Kerala vide his letter no. EL1/2/2021- 
ELEC; dated 24.08.2021 stating that Sh. Charley Thomas Panickaridam, a contesting candidate from 96- 
Ettumanoor Assembly Constituency of Kerala in General Election to the Legislative Assembly, 2021 has failed to

76/KL-LA/2021/CEMS-II, dated 06" October, 2021 was issued under sub rule (5) of Rule 89 of the Conduct of 
Elections Rules, 1961 by the Election Commission of India to Sh. Charley Thomas Panickaridam, for not lodging 
the account of Election Expenses; and 

WHEREAS, through the above said ‘Show Cause Notice’ and under sub rule (6) of Rule 89 of the Conduct of 
Elections Rules, 1961, Sh. Charley Thomas Panickaridam was directed to submit a representation in writing to the 
Commission explaining the reasons for not lodging the account and 
also to lodge account of election expenses with the District Election Officer, Kottayam within 20 days from the date 
of receipt of the notice; and 

WHEREAS, the Chief Electoral Officer, Kerala, vide his report no. EL1/2/2021-ELEC dated 30.07.2025, has 
forwarded to the Commission the original certified copy of the notice, which was served to the aforesaid candidate on 
17.11.2021, as certified by the District Election Officer, Kottayam; 

WHEREAS, the District Election Officer, Kottayam in his Supplementary Report dated 29.07.2025 as 
forwarded by the Chief Electoral Officer, Kerala vide his letter no. EL1/2/2021-ELEC; dated 30.07.2025 on account 
of the candidate, has reported that Sh. Charley Thomas Panickaridam has not submitted any representation or 
statement of correct account of election expenses. Besides, after receipt of the said notice, Sh. Charley Thomas 
Panickaridam has neither furnished any reason nor explanation to the Election Commission of India, for failure to 
lodge the account of his election expenditure as prescribed under law; and 

WHEREAS, Section 10A of the Representation of the People Act, 1951 provides that:-

(c) has failed to lodge an account of election expenses within the time and in the manner required by or under this

(d) has no good reason or justification for the failure, 

the Election Commission shall, by order published in the Official Gazette, declare him to be disqualified and any such 

person shall be disqualified for a period of three years from the date of the order.’’; 

WHEREAS, on basis of the facts and available records, the Commission is satisfied that Sh. Charley 
Thomas Panickaridam has failed to lodge his account of election expenses and has no good reason or justification 
for the failure to do so; and 

NOW, THEREFORE, in pursuance of the Section 10A of the Representation of the People Act, 1951, the 
Election Commission of India hereby declares Sh. Charley Thomas Panickaridam, resident of — Panikkaridam 
House, Arppookkara East P O, Kottayam District and a contesting candidate from 96-Ettumanoor Assembly

State or Union Territory for a period of three years from the date of this order.

New Delhi, the 12th August, 2025 


0. N. 41.—WHEREAS, the General Election to Legislative Assembly, 2021 for 97-Kottayam Assembly 
Constituency of Kerala was held in pursuance of the Election Commission of India Notification No. 464/KL- 
LA/2021, dated 1270 March, 2021; and 


WHEREAS, as per the Section 78 of the Representation of the People Act, 1951, every contesting candidate 
at an election shall, within 30 days from the date of election of the returned candidate, lodge with the District Election 
Officer an account of his election expenses which shall be a true copy of the account kept by him or his election agent 
under Section 77 of the said act; and 


WHEREAS, the result of the election for 97-Kottayam Assembly Constituency was declared by the 
Returning Officer on 027 May, 2021 and hence the last date for lodging the account of Election Expenses was 01“ 
June, 2021; and 


WHEREAS, the Commission having regard to the then prevailing pandemic situation of Covid-19, decided to 
condone any incidence of late submission of the account by candidate till 317 July, 2021; and 


WHEREAS, as per the report of the District Election Officer, Kottayam, under sub-rule (1) of Rule 89 of the 
Conduct of Elections Rules, 1961, received through the Chief Electoral Officer, Kerala vide his letter no. EL1/2/2021- 
ELEC; dated 24.08.2021 stating that Sh. Sreekumar Chakkala, a contesting candidate from 97-Kottayam Assembly 
Constituency of Kerala in General Election to the Legislative Assembly, 2021 has failed to lodge his account of 
election expenses, as required under law; and 


WHEREAS, on basis of the said report of the District Election Officer, Kottayam a ‘Show Cause Notice’ 
No. 76/KL-LA/2021/CEMS-II, dated 06" October, 2021 was issued under sub rule (5) of Rule 89 of the Conduct of 
Elections Rules, 1961 by the Election Commission of India to Sh. Sreekumar Chakkala, for not lodging the account 
of Election Expenses; and

WHEREAS, through the above said ‘Show Cause Notice’ and under sub rule (6) of Rule 89 of the Conduct of 
Elections Rules, 1961, Sh. Sreekumar Chakkala was directed to submit a representation in writing to the 
Commission explaining the reasons for not lodging the account and 


also to lodge account of election expenses with the District Election Officer, Kottayam within 20 days from the date 
of receipt of the notice; and 


WHEREAS, the Chief Electoral Officer, Kerala, vide his report no. EL1/2/2021-ELEC dated 30.07.2025, has 
forwarded to the Commission the original certified copy of the notice, which was served to the aforesaid candidate, as 
certified by the District Election Officer, Kottayam; 


WHEREAS, the District Election Officer, Kottayam in his Supplementary Report dated 29.07.2025 as 
forwarded by the Chief Electoral Officer, Kerala vide his letter no. EL1/2/2021-ELEC; dated 30.07.2025 on account 
of the candidate, has reported that Sh. Sreekumar Chakkala has not submitted any representation or statement of 
correct account of election expenses. Besides, after receipt of the said notice, Sh. Sreekumar Chakkala has neither 
furnished any reason nor explanation to the Election Commission of India, for failure to lodge the account of his 
election expenditure as prescribed under law; and 


WHEREAS, Section 10A of the Representation of the People Act, 1951 provides that:- 
“If the Election Commission is satisfied that a person- 


(a) has failed to lodge an account of election expenses within the time and in the manner required by or under this 
Act, and 


(b) has no good reason or justification for the failure, 


the Election Commission shall, by order published in the Official Gazette, declare him to be disqualified and any such 
person shall be disqualified for a period of three years from the date of the order.’’; 


WHEREAS, on basis of the facts and available records, the Commission is satisfied that Sh. Sreekumar 
Chakkala has failed to lodge his account of election expenses and has no good reason or justification for the failure 
to do so; and 


NOW, THEREFORE, in pursuance of the Section 10A of the Representation of the People Act, 1951, the 
Election Commission of India hereby declares Sh. Sreekumar Chakkala, resident of — Chakkalanarampu, 
Channanikkadu P.O. Chozhivakkadu, Kottayam and a contesting candidate from 97-Kottayam Assembly 
Constituency of Kerala in General Election to the Legislative Assembly, 2021, to be disqualified for being chosen as 
and for being a member of either House of the Parliament or the Legislative Assembly or the Legislative Council of a 
State or Union Territory for a period of three years from the date of this order.

ORDER 
New Delhi, the 7th May, 2026 


O.N. 44.—WHEREAS, the Bye-election to 10-Dehra Assembly Constituency of Himachal Pradesh, 2024, 
was held in pursuance of the Election Commission of India Notification No. 100/HP-LA/7/2024, dated 14" June, 
2024; and 


WHEREAS, as per Section 78 of the Representation of the People Act, 1951, every contesting candidate at an 
election shall, within 30 days from the date of election of the returned candidate, lodge with the District Election 
Officer an account of his/her election expenses which shall be a true copy of the account kept by him/her or his/her 
election agent under Section 77 of the said act; and 


WHEREAS, the result of the Bye-election for 10-Dehra Assembly Constituency of Himachal Pradesh, 2024 
was declared by the Returning Officer on 137 July, 2024 and hence the last date for lodging the account of Election 
Expenses was 12" August, 2024; and 


WHEREAS, as per the report dated 12.08.2024 of DEO, Kangra under sub-rule (1) of Rule 89 of the 
Conduct of Elections Rules, 1961 received through the CEO, Himachal Pradesh vide his letter no. 3-1/2024-ELN- 
EEM-IX-8462, dated 21.09.2024 stating that Advocate Sanjay Sharma, a contesting candidate from Bye-election for 
10-Dehra Assembly Constituency of state of Himachal Pradesh has failed to lodge the account of his election 
expenses, as required under law; and 


WHEREAS, on the basis of the said report of the District Election Officer, a ‘Show-Cause Notice’ No. 
76/HP-LA/10/2024/CEMS-I(Bye), dated 12" November, 2024 was issued under sub rule (5) of Rule 89 of the 
Conduct of Elections Rules, 1961 by the Election Commission of India to Advocate Sanjay Sharma, for not lodging 
of the account of Election Expenses; and 


WHEREAS, through the above said ‘Show Cause Notice’ and under sub rule (6) of Rule 89 of the Conduct of 
Elections Rules, 1961, Advocate Sanjay Sharma was directed to submit representation in writing to the Commission 
explaining the reasons for not lodging the account and also to lodge the account of his election expenses with the 
District Election Officer, Kangra District within 20 days from the date of receipt of the notice; and 


WHEREAS, the DEO, Kangra has reported that the said ‘Show Cause Notice’ was served to Advocate 
Sanjay Sharma through e-mail on date 26.11.2024; and 


WHEREAS, the District Election Officer, Kangra in his Supplementary Report no. 3-D/S (ELN)-3/2025-577; 
dated 17.02.2026 has reported that Advocate Sanjay Sharma has not submitted any representation or statement of 
account of election expenses. Further, after receipt of the said notice, Advocate Sanjay Sharma has neither furnished 
any reason nor explanation to the Election Commission of India for failure to lodge the account of his election 
expenses as prescribed under law; and 


WHEREAS, Section 10A of the Representation of the People Act, 1951 provides that:- 
“If the Election Commission is satisfied that a person- 


(a) has failed to lodge an account of election expenses within the time and in the manner required by or under 
this Act, and 


(b) has no good reason or justification for the failure, 


the Election Commission shall, by order published in the Official Gazette, declare him to be disqualified and any such 
person shall be disqualified for a period of three years from the date of the order.”’; 


WHEREAS, on basis of the facts and available records, the Commission is satisfied that Advocate Sanjay 
Sharma has failed to lodge the account of his election expenses and has no good reason or justification for the failure 
to do so; and 


112 THE GAZETTE OF INDIA : MAY 16, 2026/V AISAKHA 26, 1948 [PART II—SEC. 3(iii)] 


NOW, THEREFORE, in pursuance of Section 10A of the Representation of the People Act, 1951, the 
Election Commission of India hereby declares Advocate Sanjay Sharma, resident of Village & Post Office 
Samkar-Dhameta, Tehsil Fatehpur, District Kangra, Himachal Pradesh-176025 and a contesting candidate from 
Bye-election for 10-Dehra Assembly Constituency of State of Himachal Pradesh, to be disqualified for being chosen 
as and for being a member of either House of the Parliament or the Legislative Assembly or the Legislative Council 
of a State or Union Territory for a period of three years from the date of this order. 


[F. No. 76/HP-LA/10/2024/CEMS-I(Bye)] 
By Order,

Officer an account of his/her election expenses which shall be true copy of the account kept by him/her or his/her

WHEREAS, as per the report submitted by DEO, Sonipat dated 30.07.2024 forwarded by the Chief Electoral 
Officer, Haryana vide his letter no. 6/Elect-Exp./GEL-2024/2AE-7497 dated 05.08.2024, under sub-rule (1) of Rule 
89 of the Conduct of Elections Rules, 1961, Sh. Umesh Kumar a contesting candidate from 6-Sonipat Parliamentary 
Constituency of state of Haryana has failed to lodge account of election expenses, as required under law; and 

WHEREAS, on the basis of the said report of the District Election Officer, Sonipat a Show-Cause notice No. 
76/HR-LS/6/2024/CEMS-I, dated 8" January, 2025 was issued under sub rule (5) of Rule 89 of the Conduct of 
Elections Rules, 1961 by the Election Commission of India to Sh. Umesh Kumar for not lodging of his account of 
Election Expenses; and 

WHEREAS, through the above said Show Cause Notice and under sub rule (6) of Rule 89 of the Conduct of 
Elections Rules, 1961, Sh. Umesh Kumar was directed to submit representation in writing to the Commission 
explaining the reasons for not lodging the account and also to lodge account of election expenses with the District 
Election Officer, Sonipat within 20 days from the date of receipt of the notice; and 

WHEREAS, the District Election Officer, Sonipat vide his letter no. Election-2026/344 dated 11.03.2026 has 
informed that the notice was duly served and received by Sh. Umesh Kumar, on 09.02.2026; and

2026/344 dated 11.03.2026 has reported that Sh. Umesh Kumar has not submitted account of election expenses. 
Further, after receipt of the said notice, Sh. Umesh Kumar has neither furnished any reason nor explanation to the 
Election Commission of India, for failure to lodge the account of his election expenses as prescribed under law; and 


WHEREAS, Section 10 A of the Representation of the People Act, 1951 provides that:- 
“If the Election Commission is satisfied that a person-

के लिए मूल्यांकित कराने और संस्थान को राष्ट्रीय मूल्यांकन एवं प्रत्यायन परिषद (एनएएसी) द्वारा वैध मान्यता प्राप्त कराने 
जैसा भी मामला हो, के लिए सभी अपेक्षित कदम उठाएगा। 

छात्रों के प्रवेश, छात्रों की प्रवेश क्षमता, शैक्षणिक पाठ्यक्रम/कार्यक्रम के अनुमोदन के नवीनीकरण, छात्रों की प्रवेश क्षमता में 


संशोधन, नए पाठ्यक्रम/कार्यक्रम शुरू करने आदि के मामले में संबंधित सांविधिक परिषदों के सभी निर्धारित मानदंड और 
प्रक्रियाएं लागू रहेंगी और रथिनम ग्लोबल, कोयंबटूर, तमिलनाडु द्वारा उनका अनुपालन किया जाएगा। 


रथिनम ग्लोबल, कोयंबटूर, तमिलनाडु यूजीसी (सम विश्वविद्यालय संस्थान) विनियम, 2023 के अनुसार इस मंत्रालय और 
यूजीसी को संगम ज्ञापन प्रस्तुत करेगा। इसके अलावा, जब भी आवश्यक होगा, यह मौजूदा विनियमों के प्रावधानों के अनुसार 
अपने संगम ज्ञापन /नियमों को अद्यतित या संशोधित करेगा। 


रथिनम ग्लोबल, कोयंबटूर, तमिलनाडु यूजीसी और संबंधित सांविधिक परिषदों के नियमों और विनियमों के अनुसार शुल्क 
संरचना का पालन करेगा। 


रथिनम ग्लोबल, कोयंबटूर, तमिलनाडु इस मंत्रालय के राष्ट्रीय संस्थागत रैंकिंग फ्रेमवर्क (एनआईआरएफ) द्वारा जारी वार्षिक 
भारतीय रैंकिंग में भाग लेगा। 


रथिनम ग्लोबल, कोयंबटूर, तमिलनाडु को अनिवार्य रूप से अकादमिक बैंक ऑफ क्रेडिट (एबीसी) बनाना होगा, अपने छात्रों की 

पहचान करनी होगी और उनके क्रेडिट स्कोर को डिजिटल लॉकर में अपलोड करना होगा और यह सुनिश्चित करना होगा कि 
क्रेडिट स्कोर एबीसी पोर्टल में प्रदर्शित हों और समर्थ ई-गवर्नेस को अपनाएगा।

G.S.R. 101.—In exercise of the powers conferred by the proviso to article 309 of the Constitution, and in 
supersession of the Ministry of Agriculture, Department of Agriculture and Co-operation, Directorate of Economics 
and Statistics, Technical Assistant (Economics) Recruitment Rules, 2017, except as respects things done or omitted to 
be done before such supersession, the President hereby makes the following rules regulating the method of 
recruitment to the post of Technical Assistant (Economics) in the Economics, Statistics and Evaluation Division in 
the Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, namely:- 


1. Short title and commencement.- (i) These rules may be called Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers 
Welfare, Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Economics, Statistics and Evaluation Division, Technical 
Assistant (Economics) Recruitment Rules, 2024. 


(ii) They shall come into force on the date of their publication in the Official Gazette. 


2. Number of post, classification and Level in the Pay Matrix. — The number of post, its classification and 
the Level in the Pay Matrix attached thereto, shall be as specified in columns (2) to (4) of the Schedule annexed to 
these rules. 


3. Method of recruitment, age-limit, qualifications, etc. - The method of recruitment to the said post, age- 
limit, qualifications and other matters relating thereto shall be as specified in columns (5) to (13) of the said Schedule 
4. Disqualification.- No person - 

(a) who has entered into or contracted a marriage with a person having a spouse living; or 


(b) who, having a spouse living, has entered into or contracted a marriage with any person, shall be eligible for 
appointment to the said post: 


Provided that the Central Government may, if satisfied that such marriage is permissible under the personal law 
applicable to such person and the other party to the marriage and that there are other grounds for so doing, exempt 
such person from the operation of this rule. 


5. Power to relax.- Where the Central Government is of the opinion that it is necessary or expedient so to do, it 
may, by order and for reasons to be recorded in writing, and in consultation with the Union Public Service 
Commission, relax any of the provisions of these rules with respect to any class or category of persons.

for the post of Director in the National Test House, Department of Consumer Affairs, Ministry of Consumer Affairs, 
Food and Public Distribution, namely :-

Public Distribution, Department of Consumer Affairs, National Test House, Director, Group 'A' Post Recruitment 
Rules, 2026.

4. Disqualification.— No person, 

(a) who has entered into or contracted a marriage with a person having a spouse living or 
(b) who, having a spouse living, has entered into or contracted a marriage with any person, 
shall be eligible for appointment to the said post: 

Provided that the Central Government may, if satisfied that such marriage is permissible under the personal law 
applicable to any person and the other party to the marriage and that there are other grounds for so doing, exempt any 
person from the operation of this rule. 

5. Power to relax. - Where the Central Government is of the opinion that it is necessary and expedient to do so, it 
may, by order and for the reasons to be recorded in writing in consultation with Union Public Service 
Commission, relax any of the provisions of these rules with respect to any class or category of persons. 

6. Saving. — Nothing in these rules shall affect reservation, relaxation of age—limit and other concessions required 


to be provided for the Scheduled Castes, the Scheduled Tribes, ex—servicemen and other special categories of persons 
in accordance with the orders issued by the Central Government from time to time in this regard.

विनियम, 2023 के अनुसार माता मनसा देवी कॉम्प्लेक्स, पंचकुला, हरियाणा में ऑफ-कैंपस शुरू करने के लिए यूजीसी पोर्टल पर एक ऑनलाइन 
आवेदन प्रस्तुत किया गया था। 


2. और जबकि, यूजीसी ने दिनांक 02.01.2025 के अपने पत्र संख्या 38-2/2024 (सीपीपी-आई/डीयू) के माध्यम से सूचित किया कि 
आवेदन की स्थायी समिति के माध्यम से जांच की गई थी। समिति ने संस्था की प्रस्तुति के बाद और प्रस्तुत किए गए दस्तावेजों के आधार पर कुछ 
शर्तों के साथ राष्ट्रीय आयुर्वेद संस्थान (सम-विश्वविद्यालय), जयपुर को आशय पत्र (एलओआई) जारी करने की सिफारिश की। 


3. और आगे जबकि, मंत्रालय ने यूजीसी की सलाह पर माता मनसा देवी कॉम्प्लेक्स, पंचकूला, हरियाणा में ऑफ-कैंपस शुरू करने से 
पहले 3 वर्ष की अवधि के भीतर कुछ शर्तों को पूरा करने के लिए राष्ट्रीय आयुर्वेद संस्थान (सम विश्वविद्यालय), जयपुर को दिनांक 22.04.2025 
को आशय पत्र (एलओआई) जारी किया। 


4. और जबकि, कुलसचिव (कार्यवाहक), राष्ट्रीय आयुर्वेद संस्थान (सम विश्वविद्यालय), जयपुर ने दिनांक 07.10.2025 के 
पत्र संखया एफ.1(24)/एनआईए-पीके/आरईजी/एनआईए/2023-3890 के माध्यम से, एलओआई की शर्तों की पूर्ति के संबंध में अनुपालन रिपोर्ट 
प्रस्तुत की। इसे सत्यापन और आगे सलाह के लिए यूजीसी को भेजा गया था। इसके जवाब में, यूजीसी ने दिनांक 21.04.2026 के पत्र के माध्यम 
से सूचित किया कि अनुपालन रिपोर्ट को स्थायी समिति द्वारा स्वीकार कर लिया गया था और मामले में अंतिम अनुमोदन के लिए सिफारिश की 
गई थी।

पर, एतट्टारा राष्ट्रीय आयुर्वेद संस्थान (सम-विश्वविद्यालय), जयपुर को माता मनसा देवी कॉम्प्लेक्स, पंचकुला, हरियाणा में एक ऑफ-कैंपस केंद्र 
शुरू करने के लिए अनुमोदन प्रदान करता है। 

6. राष्ट्रीय आयुर्वेद संस्थान (सम-विश्वविद्यालय), जयपुर द्वारा इस मंत्रालय की पूर्व की अधिसूचनाओं में उल्लिखित अन्य सभी शर्तों के
